notifications.radioOfflineHelp: Notify when the radio has been unreachable for longer than the delay below. Sent as urgent, once per outage. Reboots started by Meshloom and a paused connection never notify. It cannot warn you when Meshloom itself is down: see “Meshloom started”.
notifications.radioOnlineHelp: Notify when the radio is reachable again after a Radio offline notification, with the downtime.
notifications.appStartedHelp: Notify each time Meshloom starts, with its version and whether the radio connected. Makes an unexpected restart visible and confirms an update.
notifications.radioOfflineGraceHelp: How long the radio may stay unreachable before “Radio offline” is sent. 0 notifies at once. No notification is sent in the first seconds after Meshloom starts, so a restart or an update does not raise a false alarm.
